_comment: Verification harness for PR fluid-cloudnative/fluid#6226 (dependabot: bump msgpack 1.2.2 -> 1.2.3 in the mooncake e2e image's hash-locked requirements.txt). All claims are CONTRACT polarity: they assert the intended correct lock and go red on a tampered one. Run scripts/re-verify.sh (no args) to re-run against the current PR head.

premise.claim: msgpack 1.2.2 (pinned on base in test/gha-e2e/mooncake/image/requirements.txt) is affected by GHSA-j586-36cw-2gc2 / CVE-2026-114613 (HIGH): unbounded memory leak in the C extension on strict_map_key validation failure, plus a use-after-free in Unpacker.skip().
premise.reportedComponent: msgpack-python C extension, as shipped transitively via mooncake-transfer-engine-non-cuda in the mooncake e2e test image
premise.patchedComponent: test/gha-e2e/mooncake/image/requirements.txt (the only msgpack pin in the repo)
premise.evidence: OSV query for msgpack 1.2.2 returns GHSA-j586-36cw-2gc2 (CVE-2026-114613, HIGH), range introduced:0 fixed:1.2.3; base requirements.txt pins msgpack==1.2.2. See results/osv-msgpack-1.2.2.json and results/base-msgpack-entry.txt. Exposure note: this pin is used only by the e2e test image on a kind cluster, so the practical impact of the old version here is low; the bump is nonetheless correct security hygiene and dependabot's premise is real.

integration.cmd: same script; C2 drives pip's real --require-hashes resolution+hash-verification path for python 3.12 / manylinux2014_x86_64 (the Dockerfile's constraint set)

liveNote: L3 (not run per round policy): the full docker build + mooncake e2e is exercised by the PR's own CI — kind-e2e.yml builds test/gha-e2e/mooncake/image with WITH_E2E_TEST_IMAGES=true and gha-e2e.sh runs mooncake_e2e unconditionally; green on the PR head across k8s v1.33.2/v1.30.13/v1.28.15/v1.24.17/v1.22.17.
